Request Description
### Update Corporate Client VTU Balance Threshold This endpoint is used to update the VTU (Virtual Top-Up) balance threshold for a corporate client. #### Request Body - `client_id` (integer): The unique identifier of the client. - `alertThreshold` (number): The VTU balance alert threshold. - `lowAlertThreshold` (number): The low VTU balance alert threshold. - `estimatedDurations` (array): An array of objects containing estimated duration details. - `start` (string): The start time of the estimated duration. - `end` (string): The end time of the estimated duration. - `duration` (string): The duration in minutes. #### Response - `success` (boolean): Indicates if the request was successful. - `message` (string): A message regarding the request. - `data` (object): The updated corporate client data. - `corporateId` (integer): The corporate client's unique identifier. - `userId` (integer): The user's unique identifier. - `name` (string): The name of the client. - `msisdn` (string): The client's MSISDN. - `email` (string): The client's email address. - `clientType` (string): The type of client. - `availableBalance` (number): The available balance. - `outstandingBalance` (number): The outstanding balance. - `totalCommission` (string): The total commission. - `status` (string): The status of the client. - `limit` (string): The client's limit. - `testMode` (integer): Indicates if the client is in test mode. - `createdAt` (string): The creation date. - `totalFunding` (number): The total funding. - `pendingRequest` (number): The number of pending requests. - `servicesList` (array): The list of services provided. - `serviceId` (integer): The unique identifier of the service. - `network` (string): The network of the service. - `provider` (string): The provider of the service. - `status` (string): The status of the service. - `platform` (string): The platform of the service. - `commission` (string): The commission for the service. - `createdAt` (string): The creation date of the service. - `services` (array): The list of services. - `vtuList` (array): The list of VTUs. - `id` (integer): The unique identifier of the VTU. - `msisdn` (string): The VTU's MSISDN. - `status` (string): The status of the VTU. - `balance` (string): The balance of the VTU. - `network` (string): The network of the VTU. - `name` (string): The name of the VTU. - `username` (string): The username of the VTU. - `createdAt` (string): The creation date of the VTU. - `transactionCount` (integer): The transaction count of the VTU. - `vtus` (array): The list of VTUs. - `vendingThreshold` (string): The vending threshold. - `documents` (array): The list of documents. - `documentId` (integer): The unique identifier of the document. - `corporateId` (integer): The corporate client's unique identifier. - `documentName` (string): The name of the document. - `documentUrl` (string): The URL of the document. - `createdAt` (string): The creation date of the document. - `hasVerifiedDocuments` (boolean): Indicates if the documents have been verified. - `minimumBalanceThreshold` (string): The minimum balance threshold. - `balanceNotificationEmail` (array): The list of balance notification emails. - `verificationStatus` (string): The verification status. - `verificationRequestedAt` (string): The date of verification request. - `declineReason` (null): The reason for decline. - `whiteListedIPs` (array): The list of whitelisted IPs. - `reconciliationSentAt` (string): The date of reconciliation sent. - `vtuBalanceAlertThreshold` (number): The VTU balance alert threshold. - `vtuEstimatedDuration` (number): The estimated duration for VTU.
